title: #078. University Course Timetabling
subtitle: Assign courses to rooms and timeslots obeying capacity, room exclusivity, teacher conflicts, and student cohort cliques.

judge.m0: Output must be an object { rooms, slots, totalScore }.
judge.m1: rooms[{p0}] must be an integer in [0, {p2}] (received {p1}).
judge.m2: slots[{p0}] must be an integer in [0, {p2}] (received {p1}).
judge.m4: Courses {p0} and {p1} are both scheduled in room {p2} at slot {p3}.
judge.m5: Courses {p0} and {p1} share teacher {p2} in slot {p3}.
judge.m6: Courses {p0} and {p1} share cohort {p2} in slot {p3}.
judge.m7: Reported totalScore ({p0}) does not match computed slot score ({p1}).
judge.m8: Valid timetable, but total score ({p0}) is below maximum ({p1}).
